title: console OAuth consent page shows the raw client_id instead of the app's name — it fetches /oauth2/applications/ID/public, a route the server does not serve (its public-client lookup is /oauth2/public-client)
body:
Filing-gate category ① (product defect, named landing point) and ③ — the maintainer's order in the dispatching session, verbatim: 「测试遇到的问题，可以提交issue」.

QA-source: objectstack-ai/objectstack#23104 · identity-auth.oauth-app-consent-loop · (observation outside its clauses)

**Reader who acts:** the objectui `domain:ui` execution seat (`apps/console/src/pages/auth/OAuthConsentPage.tsx`). **Dedupe:** semantic issue search on this repo, closed included, "OAuth consent page shows raw client_id public client lookup 404 wrong route applications public" — 1 hit, unrelated (objectui#11691, closed).

## Environment

objectstack `36b2889c` with the console built from objectui `1fb1ced36243` (the pin hop of objectstack-ai/objectstack#23104, since landed as `f451a5964`), stock `examples/app-showcase`, admin persona.

## What happens

During the OAuth consent loop the consent page names the requesting application by its raw `client_id`: the console's lookup of the client's public details answers 404, so it falls back to the id. The runner saw it outside the item's scored clauses; the PM seat confirmed the route mismatch in source on both sides.

## Mechanism

- objectui `1fb1ced36243` `apps/console/src/pages/auth/OAuthConsentPage.tsx:68`: ``fetch(`${AUTH_BASE}/oauth2/applications/${encodeURIComponent(clientId)}/public`, …)``.
- objectstack `main` `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-route-ledger.ts`: the served route is `GET /api/v1/auth/oauth2/public-client` (better-auth's `oauth.applications.getPublic`, `requires: 'oidcProvider'`). No `/oauth2/applications/:id/public` route is mounted.

**Expected:** the consent page names the application by its registered name, read through the route the server serves.
